body.content: Proposed simulation: vary target sum S over {138, 141, 144, 147, 150, 153} (all divisible by 3, alternating even/odd means) and test what each neighbourhood artifact's mechanism produces. For S=138 (mean 46, even): all should produce 44,46,48. For S=141 (mean 47, odd): SRC_003's mechanism would produce 45,47,49 (odd), SRC_002 would reject all, SRC_001 would note 47 is odd and break. Key observable: does 0b13382ebfe2's method produce 'no solution' or an invalid triple?
